faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MAHE Project Technical Support - III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Technical Support - III post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess an M.Sc/M.Tech/B.E degree in Computer Science, Information and Communication Technology, Data Science, Electronics, or Biomedical Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support - III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of INR 28000 plus 10% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the MAHE Project Technical Support - III posts?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any preferred qualifications for the Project Technical Support - III role?
faq.answer: Yes, UGC-CSIR/NET/GATE qualifications are preferred. Additionally, knowledge of Python (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn), time-series and signal processing, machine learning with interpretability methods, and Git-based reproducible workflows is desirable.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Project Technical Support - III post.

faq.question: Q9. Where is MAHE located?
faq.answer: MAHE is located in Manipal, Karnataka, with a pincode of 576104.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity.
